method: Read-only SELECTs over the production ledger (request_log, onchain_sales, payment_attempts), run offline by scripts/build_demand_census.py; this route only serves the file. 13 paid paths, so `challenged`/`delivered` count 402/200 on any path in main.X402_PAID_ENDPOINTS or its aliases. `totals` is derived from the `agents` list, so the rows can be re-added to check it. `ever_paid` is an ASSOCIATION, not a proof — a request row carries no wallet, so it is set when the agent got a 200 on the SAME path within 90 seconds of a settled credential (settled credentials in payment_attempts; payment_guards.delivered_at). Every window is MIN/MAX of the rows actually found, never an assumed 30 days.
